title: Etaleness of a finitely presented algebra map descends along a directed colimit of base rings
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ a directed system of commutative rings (ring maps $A_i\to A_{i'}$ for $i\le i'$, compatible), with colimit $A=\varinjlim_iA_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $0\in I$, let $B_0$ and $C_0$ be commutative $A_0$-algebras and $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ a homomorphism of $A_0$-algebras which is of finite presentation ($C_0\cong B_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ as $B_0$-algebras for some $n,m\ge0$). For $i\ge0$ regard $A_i$ as an $A_0$-algebra via the transition map, and $A$ via the coprojection, and put $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi_i=\mathrm{id}_{A_i}\otimes\varphi_0:B_i\to C_i$, and $B=A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{A_0}C_0$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0:B\to C$. If the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ induced by $\varphi$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], then there is an $i\ge0$ such that the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ induced by $\varphi_i$ is etale (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 07RI).

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RI (lemma-colimit-etale, line 47626) and its proof (presentation $C_0=B_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_{1,0},\dots,f_{m,0})$, the isomorphism $\mathrm d:(f)/(f)^2\to\bigoplus C\,\mathrm dx_k$ lifted to a finite stage); etale ring maps in the sense of $\operatorname{Spec}$ of [def-weil-etale-morphism], as in lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change
